author: IGN YouTube
text:
GTA 6 Joins Zelda As Highest-Rated Game of All Time - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
It's officially launch day for Grand Theft Auto 6 (if you're in New Zealand) and the game has racked up an impressive near-perfect 99 on Metacritic. The only other game to achieve such a feat is 1998's The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the Nintendo 64 (the recent remake scored slightly lower at 95). In related news, if you bought the Ultimate Edition of GTA 6, you might be wondering where all your bonus content is. It's actually spread throughout the game, so you'll need to progress through the story to unlock all of it. And finally, if you haven't updated your PS5's firmware yet, do so now or you won't be able to play GTA 6 when it fully unlocks. The game requires the latest firmware to even run.

The Artisan of Glimmith - Official Lunar Lights DLC Trailer | DevGamm Awards 2026
Illuminate your mind in Lunar Lights, the dazzling new expansion for The Artisan of Glimmith. Celebrate the vibrant "Glass Lights Festival" as you master 12+ new puzzle rules designed to surprise and delight artisans of all experience levels. Step into the glow and unravel the festival's mysteries. The new trailer for The Artisan of Glimmith also showcases what some critics are saying about the puzzle game. The Artisan of Glimmith is available now on PC (Steam and GOG), and the Lunar Lights expansion launches in December 2026.

DevGAMM Awards 2026
Featuring new game announcements and exclusive trailer reveals, watch this livestream of the third annual DevGAMM Awards, celebrating new AA and indie games.

Broadcast live from DevGAMM Lisbon, the ceremony brings together 70 nominees from 25 countries and special guests to reveal the winners across 12 main categories, sharing a $100,000 prize pool sponsored by Scorewarrior.

An additional $40,000+ in cash and prizes will be awarded across special categories sponsored by Epic Games Store, Unreal Engine, Godot, tinyBuild, and Unity.

Don't miss this celebration of the indie scene!
 
Learn more: https://devgamm.com/awards2026/
